name: Good Tape
description:
Bring the power of professional-grade audio transcription directly into your Claude workflow with the official Good Tape MCP server. Designed for journalists, researchers, and enterprises who handle sensitive audio and need high precision. Good Tape turns speech into text with industry-leading accuracy. 
With this integration, you can seamlessly transcribe audio files, manage transcription jobs, and pull text directly into your Claude workspace for instant summarization, analysis, translation, and more.

Key Features:
High Accuracy: Powered by state-of-the-art speech recognition optimized for 100+ languages and real-world audio conditions.

Privacy-First: Fully GDPR compliant with European data hosting and strict data handling standards.

Workflow Efficiency: Eliminate manual copy-pasting by bridging your raw audio assets directly with Claude's analytical capabilities.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Good Tape to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Good Tape to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.goodtape.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Good Tape MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Good Tape provides these MCP tools: find_tapes_by_speaker, get_notes, get_summary, get_transcription, list_transcriptions, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Good Tape?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Good Tape in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does Good Tape MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Good Tape requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Good Tape is developed by Good Tape. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
